title: Listen to John Mayer's Full SiriusXM Concert With Dolly Parton Tribute
summary: Hear John's full performance and interview with Andy Cohen on Life With John Mayer starting August 29.
body_markdown:
[John Mayer](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/john-mayer) performed an intimate SiriusXM concert at Stephen Talkhouse in Amagansett, New York, on Wednesday, August 26, delivering a career-spanning set that culminated in a moving tribute to[Dolly Parton](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/dolly-parton) .


[Life with John Mayer The ever-changing playlist Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogJohnMayerConcertLifeJohnMayer)


During the special show, brought to you by Uber, John performed with his full band for the packed Hamptons crowd before closing the night with an instrumental rendition of Parton’s “I Will Always Love You” on guitar. John then transitioned directly into his own hit “Gravity.”


Fans can hear the entire performance — along with an exclusive pre-show conversation between John and[Andy Cohen](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/andy-cohen) — when it debuts on[Life with John Mayer (Ch. 4)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/life-with-john-mayer) on Saturday, August 29, at 8pm ET (see broadcast and on demand details below).


### **Life With John Mayer Is Free 8/21–9/30**


From August 21 through September 30, listeners can tune in to[Life with John Mayer (Ch. 4)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/life-with-john-mayer) on SiriusXM car radios for FREE! No subscription necessary.


### **John Mayer Honors Dolly Parton with “I Will Always Love You”**


John paid tribute to Parton one day after the legendary singer-songwriter’s death by performing her iconic “I Will Always Love You” on guitar.


The poignant instrumental performance closed John’s Stephen Talkhouse set before seamlessly transitioning into “Gravity,” providing an emotional finale to the intimate concert.


Andy Cohen and John Mayer at Stephen Talkhouse.


Parton originally wrote and recorded “I Will Always Love You” in the 1970s, and the song became one of the defining compositions of her career before Whitney Houston famously recorded her own version.


### **How to Listen to John Mayer’s Stephen Talkhouse Concert**


The exclusive broadcast debuts Saturday, August 29, at 8pm ET on Life with John Mayer (Ch. 4) and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogJohnMayerConcertLifeJohnMayer) .


The special begins with a 20–25-minute conversation between Andy Cohen and John Mayer leading directly into John’s Stephen Talkhouse performance.

### **John Mayer Performs at Stephen Talkhouse**


John’s performance continued SiriusXM’s tradition of bringing some of music’s biggest artists to Stephen Talkhouse for intimate shows in the Hamptons.


Previous SiriusXM performers at the iconic Amagansett venue include[Brandi Carlile](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/listen-to-brandi-carliles-intimate-small-stage-series-performance-on-the-spectrum) ,[Coldplay](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/coldplay-secret-show-siriusxm) ,[Dave Matthews](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/hear-dave-matthews-exclusive-small-stage-series-set-on-dave-matthews-band-radio) ,[Ed Sheeran](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/ed-sheeran-hamptons-concert-photos) ,[Jelly Roll](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/jelly-roll-hamptons) ,[The Killers](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/hear-the-killers-perform-an-exclusive-concert-live-in-the-hamptons-for-siriusxm) ,[Metallica](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/maximum-metallica) , and[Mumford & Sons](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/mumford-sons-to-perform-exclusive-concert-in-the-hamptons-for-siriusxm-pandora) .
